parsed.why: No trans criminalisation or facility ban, but hostile climate: pride attacks, hate-crime probes failing, 2024 gender-identity propaganda law, survey showing widespread fear. Societal hostility with thin recourse; violence documented mainly against gay men.

Thin data but structurally adverse: de facto criminalisation via morality articles, no recognition, no SOGI protections, unregistrable NGOs, pervasive religious intolerance. No incidents documented — an absence of documentation, not evidence of safety; extrapolates from structural signals.

Decriminalised, no trans offence, foreign documents accepted, active LGBT civil society, Pride since 2013, tolerant polling and protective international posture. No documented targeting; only undated attacks on one activist. Open questions on custody/facilities hold it below the protections tier.

Strong formal protections, marriage equality, self-declaration ruling — but patterned transfemicide with impunity warnings, recent activist killings, documented police extortion of gender-nonconforming people, enforcement rarely uniform. Violence axis is trans-specific and recent; raw counts lack denominators.

Explicit criminalisation, no recognition or any protection, state venue raids, police warrantless searches, detention abuse, forced outing by police, online incitement to kill. State-tolerated targeting with no recourse; trans people particularly exposed under the framework.
